0022600138.text: The Houston Rockets (4-0, first in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) come in on a four-game winning streak and are 2-0 on the road, while the Milwaukee Bucks (1-3, 13th in the East) sit 5th in the Central, 2 games back. The Rockets will be without Alperen Sengun (out, back soreness) and Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and Marcus Smart is day-to-day with a forearm strain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Houston won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 119-113 in Houston on April 1, 2026.
